description: Changes due dates and verifies the saved review state and requested date range using Anki's native search. Missing Cards block the whole selection. New cards become review cards, and ranges choose a random due date; never blindly retry after an error.

due.description: Anki Set Due Date value: "0" means today, "1!" requests tomorrow with an interval reset under the current scheduler, and "3-7" chooses a random day in that range

name: reschedule-cards
title: Reschedule cards
